538:t_3:29.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Heh heh... $$キリコ$$... It seems their presence has influenced how you live, too.」

538:t_3:31.en:
$$カレン$$
「Of course. You're part of $c, after all, $$キリコ$$.」

538:t_3:32.en:
$$スザク$$
「What will you do now, $$キリコ$$?」

538:t_3:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You've got $$フィアナ$$ back, and $$ワイズマン#pilot$$, the being who twisted fate, has been slain. Your fight ends here...」

538:t_3:35.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Even if my fight is over, the fight of $c isn't.」

538:t_3:36.en:
$$キリコ$$
「No... As long as the fighting with $c isn't over, my fight isn't over either.」

538:t_3:39.en:
$$キリコ$$
「From now on, I'm still with $c.」

538:t_3:40.en:
$$カレン$$
「Of course you're more than welcome!」

538:t_3:41.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「What do you intend to do about $$フィアナ$$?」

538:t_3:42.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「If you don't mind, I'll look after her.」

538:t_3:43.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I won't hand $$フィアナ$$ over to an irresponsible busybody.」

538:t_3:44.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「...I thought it would come to this.」

538:t_3:45.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「A man who would rely on me here wouldn't be $$キリコ・キュービィー$$, after all.」

538:t_3:46.en:
$$マオ$$
「There's someone perfect for that. I've already contacted $$ゴウト$$ and the others from this end.」

538:t_3:47.en:
$$クルツ$$
「The Southeast Asia front is pretty rough too, but the $$ＥＸ－１０$$ guys are there, so they'll protect $$フィアナ$$, I bet.」

538:t_3:48.en:
$$キリコ$$
「So I'll be in debt to those guys again.」

538:t_3:49.en:
$$マオ$$
「No need to worry about it. They were crying with joy.」

538:t_3:50.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You're loved, huh. Both you and sweet $$フィアナ$$.」

538:t_3:52.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Perfect timing. Let's ask the unit that's bringing Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ to us to transport $$フィアナ$$.」

538:t_3:54.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Word came in a while ago. For the next operation, she alone will join us.」

538:t_3:55.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$キリコ$$... It may be a short time, but until then, spend it with her.」

538:t_3:60.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Amid my comrades' voices of celebration, I was thinking about the meaning of the future of despair that $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ spoke of...)

538:t_3:61.en:
$$キリコ$$
(But no one knows the future. In that case, it should be possible to turn despair into hope.)

538:t_3:62.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Now that I know $$フィアナ$$ was alive, a light has been born within me.)

538:t_3:63.en:
$$キリコ$$
(If it's to protect that, I can keep fighting... Today... and tomorrow, too...)

538:t_10:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「What is that, $$ＡＧ$$!? What's that you're holding in your hand!」

538:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What? Well... as you can see, it's a bunny suit.」

538:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To commemorate settling things with that $$カン・ユー$$, I thought you could look back on your history with him, so I'd really like you to wear this...」

538:t_10:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Is that all you have to say?」

538:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(This is bad... She's about five seconds from really losing it...)

538:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-anyway, Ms. $$カレン$$'s anger at $$カン・ユー$$ produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

538:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, I'll be excusing myself now...」

538:t_10:13.en:
$$カレン$$
「Leaving that bunny suit with you never leads to anything good. As compensation for all the trouble so far, I'll take it.」

538:t_10:15.en:
$$カレン$$
「What should I do with it... Maybe I'll wear it if there's some kind of party...」

538:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It seems you actually like it quite a bit, after all.」

538:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, Mr. $$シャッコ$$. You've splendidly fulfilled your duty as the hero of $$クエント$$.」

538:t_10:26.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Since I have the chance, I'll say it. You give off the same smell as that $$ワイズマン#pilot$$.」

538:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I take more care with fragrance than any human... no, any robot, but...」

538:t_10:30.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「But I'm the same as $$クロウ$$. There's a part of me that believes in you somewhere.」

538:t_10:32.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「So don't do anything that would betray us.」

538:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course! Trust is a treasure in the business world!」

538:t_10:36.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「I still feel uneasy, though...」

538:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At times like that, put some spirit into it and blow the haze away! Let's go all out again today...!」

538:t_10:40.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「I feel like I've been neatly talked around somehow...」

539:t_000:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh ho! They've even restored the Cathedral properly!」

539:t_000:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's not something the guy who wrecked it should say.」

539:t_000:3.en:
$$ボビー$$
「So in the end, they wouldn't agree to talks beforehand, huh?」

539:t_000:4.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「From their point of view, $c carried out the $$赫い霍乱$$. It can't be helped.」

539:t_000:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I doubt it would do any good to bring up that they kidnapped $$フィアナ$$ and caused even more chaos in the world.」

539:t_000:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「To His Holiness Pope $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ of the $$マーティアル$$ Church. This is Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$ of $c.」

539:t_000:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「As notified in advance, we request an audience to hear what you have to say.」

539:t_001:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Look! There are $$ファイヤバグ$$s too!」

539:t_001:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「It seems $$マーティアル$$ is still connected to $$アマルガム$$ behind the scenes.」

539:t_001:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Is that why they came at us on $$神根島$$...?」

539:t_001:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It can't be helped. Launch the mobile units.」
